newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Holiday tightens supplies.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Holiday tightens supplies.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were little changed on Monday although tightness in quick-delivery supplies was reported as some locations following the long holiday weekend, dealers said.
They noted Friday's U.S. Independence Day national holiday had slowed mill run times which had tightened up supplies. Demand, however, remained generally sluggish.
"When supplies pick up it is going to be difficult to avoid going lower," one dealer said, noting that demand was unlikely to pick-up until pastures start to dry out in August.
Dealers said low milk prices continued to restrict demand for millfeeds from the dairy sector.
